title: Specify one common Gallery runtime
scope: Inventory desktop and mobile Gallery behavior and define one platform-neutral runtime contract for scene lifecycle, controls, stepping, rendering handoff and diagnostics.
acceptance: A tracked ownership matrix names every desktop/mobile responsibility and assigns it to the common runtime, a renderer adapter or a platform shell.
Characterization tests pin scene selection, reset, pause, foreground recovery and controller behavior that later extraction must preserve.
evidence: PASS: docs/GALLERY-RUNTIME.md tracks current desktop/mobile ownership, required runtime/renderer/shell boundaries, state transitions, rendering handoff and diagnostics.
PASS: ctest --test-dir build-foundations --output-on-failure -R ^parallel-mater-(gallery-(session-contract|input|frame-timing)-tests|camera-controller-tests)$; Slang CPU; 4/4 tests passed.
